newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH STATE 5-YR BOND AVERAGE PRICE 101.93 - manager.
newsitem.headline: CZECH STATE 5-YR BOND AVERAGE PRICE 101.93 - manager.

text.p: The average price at an auction of Czech 10.95 percent five-year bonds was 101.93 percent, auction manager OFT Brokers said in a statement on Monday.

It added that the auction of 654.3 million crowns worth of bonds, which were leftover from 1996, was oversubscribed with a total of 1.15 billion crowns in bids. Bids totalling 654.3 million crowns were accepted.
The statement said maximum price at the auction was 102.16 percent, while the minimum price was 101.80 percent.
The bonds were issued last August when only 1.9 billion crowns worth were actually sold.
The excess has now been completely sold off, OFT said.
